note.meikon.1.body:
We respectfully announce the wedding of Sayo and %1$s.
We humbly request your presence as the groom.

  When: tonight, at the hour of the ox
  Where: the hidden world, Sayo's mansion

- Inside the envelope is a lock of long black hair.
It is still damp.
note.meikon.1.title: Invitation
note.meikon.10.body:
Purifying salt drives her away.
When she is upon you, throw it in her face. (right-click)
Use it on the floor to heap a ward she will not cross for a while.

A thrown marble clatters where it lands.
She goes toward the sound.

An ofuda frees you from her hands, once.
note.meikon.10.title: Salt and Marbles
note.meikon.11.body:
Never touch the three sake cups in the wedding hall.
Drink with her and the wedding is done, and you will never go back.

...Still, she waits.
Every night, with the cups ready.
note.meikon.11.title: Do Not Drink
note.meikon.12.body:
(A crayon drawing: a woman in a white kimono, and a small child.)

big sister walks the hallway every night
dont look at big sisters face
if you look she will make you her husband


big sister is behind you right now
note.meikon.12.title: A Child's Drawing
note.meikon.2.body:
May, 1923

The young mistress is to be married, to the son of a kimono merchant in town.
Every night she gazes at her white wedding kimono and rings her bells.
The seven bells of the wedding procession. Her favourites.

Lately the lamps in the corridor keep going out at night.
note.meikon.2.title: Maid's Diary I
note.meikon.3.body:
Never let your lantern die.
Shadows live in the dark. They come to those without light, and drink their fire.
Turn your light on a shadow; it cannot keep its shape in the light.

But remember:
She sees the light too. Even from far away, the one who carries it is found.
When you feel her near, put out the flame and keep low.

Running is loud. Running with bells is louder.
note.meikon.3.title: On Light
note.meikon.4.body:
The night before the wedding, the groom disappeared.
The mistress waited at the gate all night in her white kimono.
When dawn came, she did not return.

They found her at the bottom of the well in the courtyard, still in her hood,
smiling.

Since that day, at night, there are footsteps in the corridor,
and a voice singing "kagome, kagome".
note.meikon.4.title: Maid's Diary II
note.meikon.5.body:
It was too cruel to let her go alone.
Following the old custom, I had a mukasari ema painted: a wedding in the afterlife.

For the groom's face I had the painter paint a living man.
The man who abandoned her.

Paint the living on the ema, and they are taken.
I knew. I knew, and I had it painted.

But when he vanished she was not satisfied.
The groom's face was scraped away from the painting.
She is still looking for a new groom.
note.meikon.5.title: Mother's Note
note.meikon.6.body:
On severing the bond

The bride's procession carried seven bells, the tokens that bind bride and groom.

Gather all seven bells scattered through the mansion and keep ringing them under the torii in the courtyard,
and the bond will be cut; the living may return to their world.

But the ringing calls her.
Do not stop until it is done.

The storehouse key, the altar candles, the headless doll, and the well.
The last bells sleep there.
note.meikon.6.title: The Priest's Note
note.meikon.7.body:
Never turn your back on the Ichimatsu dolls.
While you watch them they do not move. Look away, and they come closer.
Where there is no light, you are not really seeing them.

The doll on the top step has lost her head.
The mistress tore it off in a tantrum.
It must be somewhere in the child's room.
note.meikon.7.title: About the Dolls
note.meikon.8.body:
If she finds you, run.
When she loses sight of you, get into a closet and close the door.
You can see out through the slats. She cannot see in.

But if she sees you go in, it is over.

If she stands before the door - hold your breath. (keep holding Shift)
Frightened breathing carries through the door.
note.meikon.8.title: In the Closet
note.meikon.9.body:
Light the altar candles in order.
The wrong order angers the ancestors.

The order is:

  %2$s

Light them rightly and a bell returns before the altar.
There are matches in the kitchen drawers.
note.meikon.9.title: Rites of the Altar Room
